rationale: Independent reading: EO 13018 (61 FR 49045) only changes '15' to '18' in sec. 3(a) of EO 12975. Held EO 13316 (68 FR 55255-55256) sec. 3(b) revokes 'Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046, and 13137'. Contrary to the producer's note, EO 13018 is named in that revocation (as an amending order of the revoked parent), so this is not mere inference; EO 13137 had also already replaced sec. 3. No savings clause. I agree: NO.
